title: T1491.001 — Defacement - Internal Defacement
subtitle: Interactive walkthrough of Defacement - Internal Defacement with the technique-specific attack path and defender evidence.

steps.title: Foothold
steps.caption: The attacker sends a phishing email with an infected document. An employee opens it. The document starts PowerShell, and the attacker now runs commands on workstation WKS-2211. Defenders later see one Office application spawning a scripting process, a common first clue
steps.defender: WAF, reverse-proxy and application logs record the request, payload and backend behavior.

steps.title: Escalate
steps.caption: The attacker steals saved credentials from the workstation and uses them to log on to other systems, including the database server and the domain controller. Defenders see several new logons with the same account within minutes, from machines the user never touches normally

steps.title: Tamper
steps.caption: The attacker runs an UPDATE statement against the internal database that feeds the staff dashboard. Headlines change to attacker-chosen text. Defenders find a database audit row showing an unusual service account writing to a content table outside the release window
